title: Add vertical manual scrolling and auto-scroll toggle to ShortSport

requirements.summary: Implement TikTok-style vertical manual scrolling with snap behavior for video reels
acceptanceCriteria: Each reel occupies the full viewport height and snaps into place when scrolling
Users can manually scroll up and down through video reels
Scroll snapping ensures only one reel is visible at a time

file_operations.description: Replace the current auto-scroll implementation with a scroll-snap container. Wrap the video reels in a full-height scrollable container with CSS scroll-snap-type: y mandatory. Configure each video container with scroll-snap-align: start to ensure snap-to-viewport behavior. Remove or refactor the existing auto-advance timer logic to support the new manual scrolling paradigm while preserving the mute toggle and like functionality.

Add CSS utility classes or global styles to support scroll-snap behavior for vertical scrolling. Include styles for scroll-snap-type, scroll-snap-align, and any necessary smooth-scroll or overflow properties to ensure each video reel snaps cleanly into the viewport.

requirements.summary: Add floating auto-scroll toggle button with visual state indicator in the bottom-right corner
acceptanceCriteria: A floating button is visible in the bottom-right corner of the ShortSportPage
Clicking the button enables auto-scroll mode, which automatically advances to the next reel at a regular interval
Clicking the button again disables auto-scroll mode
The button changes appearance (e.g., color or icon) to reflect active vs inactive state
Auto-scroll stops when the last reel is reached or when manually toggled off

file_operations.description: Add a floating toggle button positioned in the bottom-right corner of the page using fixed positioning. Implement state to track whether auto-scroll mode is active. When active, use a setInterval or requestAnimationFrame loop to programmatically scroll to the next reel using scrollIntoView or scrollBy. Change the button's icon or color to visually indicate active (e.g., pause icon or highlighted color) vs inactive (e.g., play icon or default color) state. Ensure auto-scroll stops when reaching the last reel or when the user manually toggles it off.
